Disgusting and disappointing
May 2026 • Solo
Absolutely appalling experience at Panorama Hotel’s rooftop pool. I paid 200,000 VND for access and was forced to leave mid-session because the hotel made an internal room booking error — not my fault, not my problem, yet I was the one inconvenienced. Upon returning, staff refused to provide me with a towel or a day bed, despite the fact that I had already paid and was displaced due to THEIR mistake. The attitude from staff was dismissive, rude, and completely incompetent — zero accountability, zero customer service.
And then the piece de résistance: a tampon sitting on the ledge of the pool. I’ll let that sink in. At a rooftop pool charging entry fees, the hygiene standards are so low that used feminine products are left poolside. This is not just disgusting — it’s a health and safety issue.
Save your 200k and go literally anywhere else in Nha Trang. This place is an embarrassment to hospitality.
